description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a raincloudplot graphics object.

tr.td: updates the annotation metadata used by interactive tools and object inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle when no annotation is attached.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether an interrupting callback is queued or canceled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector.
updates clipping during the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates the content used for interactive data tips.
Type: data tip template object or empty handle value. Supported values: a data tip template object owned by the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle when data tips are not configured.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
sets the maximum rain cloud plot width in units of the positional grouping data.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar value.
updates the label used by legend entries and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the cloud outline color; follows FaceColor while EdgeColorMode is 'auto'.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or 'none'.
'auto' makes EdgeColor follow FaceColor; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets the transparency of the cloud and of the marker faces.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: values in [0,1].
sets the cloud fill color; the default comes from the axes ColorOrder and SeriesIndex.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or 'none'.
'auto' takes FaceColor from the axes ColorOrder; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
controls whether handle-search functions can find the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls whether a running callback can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the cloud outline width and the marker edge width in points.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar value.
sets the marker symbol of the rain.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'o', '+', '*', '.', 'x', 'square', 'diamond', '^', 'v', '>', '<', 'pentagram', 'hexagram', 'none'.
sets the marker outline color; follows EdgeColor while MarkerEdgeColorMode is 'auto'.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or 'none'.
'auto' makes MarkerEdgeColor follow EdgeColor; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets the marker fill color; follows FaceColor while MarkerFaceColorMode is 'auto'.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or 'none'.
'auto' makes MarkerFaceColor follow FaceColor; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets the marker area in points squared.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar value.
chooses the plot alignment: with 'horizontal' the sample values are along the x-axis.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'horizontal', 'vertical'.
sets the axes that owns the object.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: axes or hggroup handle.
controls whether visible or all object parts can be picked.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
marks the object as selected or not selected.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls display of selection handles.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
selects the axes ColorOrder row used by the automatic colors.
Type: positive numeric scalar. Supported values: positive whole number.
stores the table used to create the chart.
Type: table or empty value. Supported values: [] or a table supplied to raincloudplot.
stores user-defined text for identifying the object.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'raincloudplot'.
stores user-defined data on the object.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
shows or hides the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the positional grouping data used to place the rain clouds.
Type: real numeric vector. Supported values: finite numeric values; nonfinite values are ignored for drawing.
'auto' when the positions come from a table or from the defaults; 'manual' when XData is assigned.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the table variable name used for x data.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the sample data.
Type: real numeric vector. Supported values: finite numeric values; nonfinite values are ignored for drawing.
'auto' when the samples come from a table; 'manual' when YData is assigned.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the table variable name used for the sample data.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
